title: [Autour de La "Longue Marche" à travers la théorie de Galois, pages 1 à 67] : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is an early section of the 1981 'Longue Marche' manuscript notes, where Grothendieck sets up notation for fundamental groups and groupoids of a morphism f: X -> Y.

Notation and identifications:
- E^T_X is (at least as the notation suggests) the profinite fundamental group of X at a geometric base point T, π_1(X,T).
- E^T_{X/Y} is the 'relative' fundamental group: the fundamental group of the geometric fibre X_{ξ_Y} at T.
- E^T_Y is the fundamental group of the base Y.
- The previous page warns that E_{X/Y}, without a base point, is a diagram of profinite groups linked by isomorphisms (a transitive system up to inner automorphisms), not a single outer group. The arbitrariness of the identifications E^T_{X/Y} ≅ E^{T'}_{X/Y} comes from the choice of an element of E^T_X, which acts on the normal subgroup E^T_{X/Y} by inner automorphisms.

The extension: the pair (E_X, E_{X/Y}) suggests viewing E^T_X as an extension of E^T_Y (or of some group canonically associated with it) by E^T_{X/Y}. This is the homotopy exact sequence 1 -> π_1(X_ȳ) -> π_1(X) -> π_1(Y) -> 1 (SGA1 IX/X, under the usual properness/separability hypotheses). Within it:
- E^T_{X/Y} plays the role of 'our π', the geometric fundamental group.
- E^T_Y plays the role of a Galois group, an 'arithmetic' profinite group.

Main case: the case of interest is Y = Spec K, K a field. There E_Y ≅ E_Y^{ȳ} is Gal(K̄/K), and one gets the fundamental exact sequence 1 -> π_1(X_K̄) -> π_1(X) -> Gal(K̄/K) -> 1.

Purpose: this sets up the 'π versus Γ' (geometric versus arithmetic) framework underlying the anabelian programme and the Galois action on Teichmüller groupoids. The next page continues with Γ_K and with function fields L/K and their proper regular models.
errors: No mathematical error. The extension E_X -> E_Y need only be surjective under hypotheses (e.g. f proper with geometrically connected fibres, or Y = Spec K with X geometrically connected); the page leaves this implicit and hedges with 'vu dans un groupe convenable'.

deep.surprise_reason: Standard setup material (homotopy exact sequence, geometric vs arithmetic π_1) that Grothendieck himself published in SGA1 and used in the Esquisse; it is expository notation-fixing.
transcription_corrections: Line 1 likely reads 'd'un él[ément] de E^T_X, opérant sur le sous-groupe E^T_{X/Y} par automorphismes intérieurs', not 'd'une s[?]l. ... reposant ... par extension intérieure'.
'Les relations (E_X, E_{X/Y}) suggèrent intuitivement qu'il convient de regarder E^T_X comme une extension...': the underlined word is plausibly 'extension' (possibly 'catégorie'; uncertain).
'(vu dans un des groupes convenable étendu)' may rather be '(ou de l'un de ses groupes canoniquement associés)'; uncertain.
Last line: 'E_Y ≃ E_Y^{ȳ}' (superscript is the geometric point ȳ, not Y).
